name: XST self-skim treated as a buy mints rebase supply into the pair
summary: XStable2 treats every transfer out of a supported pool as a buy and raises _totalSupply by the expansion mint, which rebases all balances including the pool's, without checking that tokens actually left the pool. pair.skim(pair) is such a transfer that moves nothing, so the attacker looped 15 self-skims to inflate the XST/WETH pair's XST balance above its reserves, skimmed the surplus to itself and sold it into the pair for WETH.
notes: Campaign: every transaction with an XST Transfer from the XST/WETH pair to itself (the self-skim) since the proxy's creation; the anchor is the first, followed by ten copycats from four senders over the next week. XST is the only supported pool (getSupportedPools(1) reverts).

Loss counts only the pair's WETH; the XST the attackers skimmed from it is unpriced and was sold back into the same pair, so its value is already in the WETH (rule 12). 0x4fbb8840, the anchor's XST seller, is the attacker's contract (the transaction's to).
